post.description: Start here when the 4x4 dataset id is unknown: find the dataset, then call `dataset` for its columns and `rows` for its data. Only results with type `dataset` (and a non-null api_url) have rows.

category.description: Exact portal category as returned by `facets` (for example `Housing and Buildings`).

cursor.description: Opaque `next_cursor` from the previous page; send it with the same search parameters.

dataset_id.description: Look up one asset by 4x4 id (for example `3i4a-hu95`) or by a data.sf.gov / data.sfgov.org URL containing it. Unknown ids are not_found.

limit.description:
Results per page (1-100).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 20.

only.description:
Restrict to one asset type. `datasets` are the tabular assets that `rows` can query.

Provider reference: allowed values ["datasets", "maps", "filters", "charts", "hrefs", "files", "stories", "measures", "visualizations"].

order.description:
Sort order. `relevance` (default) needs a `query`; the others are descending except `name`.

Provider reference: allowed values ["relevance", "updatedAt", "createdAt", "name", "page_views_total", "page_views_last_month", "page_views_last_week", "download_count"]; default "relevance".

query.description: Free-text search over names, descriptions, tags and columns, for example `zoning` or `building permits`.

tags.description: Portal tags as returned by `facets`; an asset must carry all of them.

200.description:
Search the DataSF catalog through the Socrata Discovery API (search_context=data.sf.gov): free-text query, asset type, category, tags and sort order, or look up one asset by its 4x4 id. Each result carries the 4x4 dataset id, name, type (dataset, map, filter, href, chart, story ...), description, category, tags, timestamps, column field names and datatypes, download and view counts, the landing link, permalink and, for tabular datasets, the SODA api_url to pass to `rows`. Paged by `limit` and an opaque `cursor`. An unknown `dataset_id` is not_found; a query with no match is a successful empty result.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `datasets` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_url` | string | SODA endpoint https://data.sf.gov/resource/<id>.json for tabular datasets; null for other asset types. |
| `attribution` | string |  |
| `attribution_link` | string |  |
| `category` | string |  |
| `columns` | object[] | Column field names (SoQL identifiers), display names and datatypes; empty for non-tabular assets. |
| `created_at` | string |  |
| `data_updated_at` | string |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `domain` | string |  |
| `download_count` | number |  |
| `id` | string | Socrata 4x4 asset id. |
| `license` | string |  |
| `link` | string | Landing page on the portal. |
| `metadata_updated_at` | string |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `page_views_total` | number |  |
| `parent_ids` | string[] | 4x4 ids of the datasets a derived view (map, filter, chart) is built on. |
| `permalink` | string |  |
| `provenance` | string | `official` or `community`. |
| `tags` | string[] |  |
| `type` | string | Asset type as reported: dataset, map, filter, href, chart, story, file, measure, visualization ... |
| `updated_at` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Any question that needs actual records from a DataSF dataset. Get the 4x4 id from `datasets` and the column field names from `dataset` first. Use `row_count` to size a query before paging.

cursor.description: Row offset to start from: the `next_cursor` of the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

dataset_id.description: 4x4 id (for example `3i4a-hu95`) or a data.sf.gov / data.sfgov.org URL containing it.

filters.description: Bare equality filters sent as `field=value` query parameters (for example {"blklot": "3720009"}); keys must be column field names, values strings.

limit.description:
Rows per page. The portal caps a request at 50000; wide datasets with geometry should use far less.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50000; default 100.

order.description: SoQL $order, for example `filed_date DESC` or `count(*) DESC`. Default `:id` when no `group` is given.

q.description: SoQL $q full-text search across all text columns.

select.description: SoQL $select, for example `zoning_sim,districtna` or `zoning_sim,count(*)`. Default: all columns.

where.description: SoQL $where, for example `zoning_sim like 'RH-1%'`, `filed_date between '2026-09-01T00:00:00' and '2026-09-02T00:00:00'`, `intersects(the_geom,'POINT(-122.3966 37.7897)')`, `within_circle(point,37.7897,-122.3966,50)`.

200.description:
Query rows of any DataSF dataset through the SODA 2.1 endpoint https://data.sf.gov/resource/<4x4>.json with SoQL: `select` (columns, aggregates such as count(*)), `where` (SoQL predicates incl. like, between, intersects(the_geom,'POINT(lon lat)'), within_circle(point, lat, lon, meters), within_box), `order`, `group`, `q` (full text) and `filters` (bare field=value equality parameters), paged with `limit` (1-50000, default 100) and `cursor` (row offset). Without `order` (and without `group`) the program orders by the row id `:id` so pages are stable. Rows come back exactly as published: numbers and dates are strings, geometry is GeoJSON; `columns` lists the returned field names and Socrata types from the X-SODA2-Fields/Types headers. An unknown dataset id is not_found; a SoQL error (unknown column, bad syntax) is invalid_input carrying the portal's message; an empty page is a successful result with count 0.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `rows` as the primary payload key.

The provider does not publish a field list for this tool.

These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
